description: Land Title Settlement Department - Etamurungagoda, Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320315
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) in various villages, with detailed schedules listing property owners, extents, encumbrances, and other land-related particulars. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations and title determinations.
